description:
Play Boros Garrison.
Kodama of the East Tree, Auton Soldier, and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
Auton Soldier and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Auton Soldier token's trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
